evidence.detail: The Runnable loops while enabled, sleeps exactly 50 ms between iterations, and under a synchronization lock records the current Client.hP and Client.hQ mouse coordinates.
The class owns two parallel int[500] arrays and a sample-count field; each tick appends one x/y coordinate pair until the 500-sample cap is reached.
Client constructs exactly one rs/b/a during initialization, launches it as a dedicated runnable, resets its sample count on session reset/login state setup, and disables/releases it during shutdown.
No surviving exact-v308 class directly reads the stored coordinate arrays; therefore the proposed name describes the proven sampling behavior only and does not assert a telemetry/network destination.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the dedicated 50 ms mouse-coordinate sampler. The historical downstream use of the retained samples is not claimed.
